new_results.statement: In the r40 exact-rank-three true-near-coloop split, if C is the H-side self matrix in the left-SVD basis of the physical H-T crossing, sigma_min(C)>beta0*s with beta0=(34/111)(17/288). Hence the third column (d,alpha) obeys sqrt(||d||^2+alpha^2)>beta0*s uniformly even when the third cross singular value tends to zero.

For every hub-leaf pair in the near-coloop frame, if delta=max_k||w_k||^2, then max extension mass <=delta times total extension mass and W2>=(1-delta)|det M|^2 g_0j^2. In the actual r40 hard branch delta<1/36, W2>(35/36)|det M|^2 g_0j^2.
